description: Source-only byte-preserved copies of original nested experiment launchers; not a standalone runnable experiment or execution receipt.
scope: seeds43-47 outer selection locking and launch
historical_boundary: Seed44-47 inner launch adaptations and diskguard bypass were in-memory operator commands, not edits to the original seed43 template. Those executed command variants are not reconstructed or supplied here.
usage_notes: For historical source inspection. Executing launch entry points can submit Kubernetes GPU jobs and write experiment directories; none were executed during this transfer.
Original absolute cluster paths, pinned controllers/workers, contracts, settings, environment locks, runtime dependencies and experiment artifacts are required; they are not bundled here.
Original entry points: seed43 inner and seed44 recovery launch with no arguments; outer launcher requires --seed 43 through 47. These are documentation only, not instructions to launch locally.
No experiment data or Train.py modifications are included; publishing these files does not submit any jobs.

verification.byte_equality: All three copies compared directly with original source bytes.
verification.syntax: AST parse and compile without execution for all three files and the seed43 embedded RUNTIME.
verification.credential_scan: Static heuristic checks for private keys, common provider tokens, literal credential assignments and credential-bearing URLs; no matches. Not a guarantee of absence.
